message: With classes all wrapped up for the day, it's after school.

name: Momiji
message: 「Good work today. Sensei, got a minute？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, what's up？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you've got time after this, I was hoping you could train with me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, that's rare. You're actually eager to train?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, I've been doing solo practice like normal this whole time, you know？」

name: Momiji
message: 「It's just that zazen really stressed me out today. So I was thinking I wanna move around a bit~」

name: Iori
message: 「Zazen stressed you out...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Just sitting there without thinking about anything is pure torture, isn't it?」

name: Iori
message: 「W-Well, I guess... Sorry, though. I've got remedial lessons with Ririmu right now.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, I see~ Guess it can't be helped, then.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll definitely spar with you next time.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah... Well, see ya~」
Momiji looks a little disappointed as she leaves the classroom. I'm bummed too, but it can't be helped.

name: Iori
message: 「All right, since I turned down her offer, I'd better make this count！ He~y, Ririmu~！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehhh~~ We're seriously doing this~？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, first up is a quick quiz to see where you're at. Go ahead and start.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「All do~ne！ Well then, catch ya later, Iorin~♪」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoa！？ Caught me~！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hold it. I'll grade it right now, so sit down.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Mgh, let go of me~! I did it, so we're done, right!」
I grab Ririmu by the arm as she tries to make a break for it and sit her back down.

name: Iori
message: 「...I see. This is pretty bad. Even worse than I thought.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Urgh... I actually tried, you know！ I really did！ You think I'm lying, don't you！」

name: Iori
message: 「I don't think you're lying. It's just that every single question on this quiz was lowered to a middle-school level.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, really？」
Even during remedial lessons, Ririmu's grasp of the material was uneven—some parts she understood, and others she didn't.
So when I narrowed the questions down to middle-school level, she missed them across the board.

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, is there some reason you don't seem to know any middle-school material at all？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... Well, the reason's pretty clear, I guess」

name: Ririmu
message: 「My parents have been super strict ever since I was a kid, y'know? I hated it, so I ran away from home.」
Ah, now that she mentions it, she did tell me that before.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Because of that, I barely went to school at all during middle school.」

name: Iori
message: 「Where did you spend your time？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Downtown, mostly. I stayed at hotels. They never froze my credit card, after all.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Well, I guess they figured it was better than me turning to crime.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「At first, some guys my parents hired came to drag me back, though」

name: Ririmu
message: 「You know how strong I am, right？ Once I beat every single one of them, they gave up pretty quick.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you're quite the tomboy.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「While I was living out in the city like that, there were tons of people with reasons just like mine」

name: Ririmu
message: 「They couldn't study to save their lives, but there were so many people I could really respect, and people making their dreams come true all on their own.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I mean, fashion, hanging out—there were whole worlds out there I'd never even known about！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Staying up till morning talking with friends and stuff—it was super fun！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「People who really shine, y'know, they all have their own worldview, and they stay true to it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「So I thought, I want to be like that too.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I started wanting to do what I want to do, and stay true to my own worldview.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「......Ugh, totally put you off, didn't I? You're probably thinking, 'What is she doing instead of studying?'」

name: Iori
message: 「No, I don't think that at all.」

name: Iori
message: 「Long ago, back in the Sengoku period, there were samurai known as 'kabukimono'—have you ever heard of them？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehhh, more history studyin'？」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, no, that's not it. The kabukimono mindset I just mentioned is just like you, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「Living for your own sense of aesthetics—that's what a kabukimono is.」

name: Iori
message: 「They'd even put their lives on the line for their aesthetics and beliefs. Some of them even went head-to-head against the rulers of their time like that.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「For real？ Whoa, people like that actually existed！」

name: Iori
message: 「So I don't think your way of thinking is weird at all, Ririmu.」

name: Iori
message: 「There have always been a certain number of people like that throughout history, and sometimes they're the ones who shake up the whole world.」

name: Iori
message: 「I hope you can become someone like that someday too, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Th-Thanks... for understanding. I think that's the first time anyone's ever said something like that to me...」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Like, I just don't think Jindou should be all about strength, y'know?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Being fashionable and stylish—all of that is part of Jindou too, right?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That's why I'm a swordswoman, sure, but I'm a model too. The Jindou stage is my runway.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「I wanna show that off in the ultimate way at the Martial Festival！ That's my dream！」

name: Iori
message: 「I think that's awesome. I'll back you up with everything I've got.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Really？ Thanks a ton, Iorin！」

name: Iori
message: 「And so, here's step one of my all-out support.」
I toss a hologram over toward Ririmu.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm？ What's this？」

name: Iori
message: 「Memorize all of it. By tomorrow.」
What I tossed to Ririmu is a history textbook loaded onto the hologram.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Wh-Whaaaaat？！」

name: Iori
message: 「If you're a model walking the ultimate runway that is the Martial Festival, something like this should be a piece of cake.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「H-Hey, putting it like that is totally unfair！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Pass your midterms without a hitch, Ririmu, and show me the best fashion show ever.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「U-Ughhhhh... okay.」
Ririmu hangs her head with a defeated slump.
